description:
Get the count of daily active users in the reporting period by product.

TIP: Gets daily active user counts across Microsoft 365 services. The period parameter must be one of: D7, D30, D90, D180. Returns CSV data with daily counts per service: office365, exchange, oneDrive, sharePoint, skypeForBusiness, yammer, teams.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-active-user-counts-report
